scope: Quotations containing an ellipsis ("...", "…", ". . .") inside quotation marks in the archive's own writing: every Table-field cell (footnotes, editorNotes, recordDates) and every text field on all entries, categories and assets, live elements only (drafts and revisions excluded); plus the unapplied draft files inventory/review/*-draft-*.json and *profiles*.json.
method: Craft read via storage/runtime/ellipsis_dump.php (703 field values containing an ellipsis; 126 footnote rows with source editorial-2026). Legacy bodies (photographs, articles, documents, obituaries, war memorial legacyHtml) are the source's words and out of scope. Each quotation was split at its ellipses and each piece located in the source; the omitted text was read and judged.

rows.title: Denis DeFigueiredo: School Board Member, Sulphur Springs Union School District
rows.quotation: shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board ... as if elected at a district election.
rows.source: Education Code 5328 (text via california.public.law, which reproduces leginfo; leginfo itself returned a Cloudflare challenge to this agent; the same opening words are quoted from leginfo in scripts/import/unopposed_not_appointed_2026_10_05.php)
rows.sourcePassage: Education Code 5328 (whole section): "If pursuant to Section 5326 a district election is not held, the qualified person or persons nominated shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board, or if no person has been nominated or if an insufficient number is nominated, the governing board shall appoint a qualified person or persons, as the case may be, at a meeting prior to the day fixed for the election, and such appointee or appointees shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board as if elected at a district election."
rows.note: The ellipsis joins the nominee clause ("the qualified person or persons nominated shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board") to the appointee clause ("such appointee or appointees shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board as if elected at a district election"). "As if elected" applies in the statute only to persons the board appoints when too few are nominated. This is the same splice fixed on 27 records on 5 October; #28497 was outside that script's ID list because the appointed-terms audit judged its 2007 claim UNSUPPORTED, so the quotation was not corrected. The row also still opens "Appointed without an election".
rows.corrected: when the election is not held "the qualified person or persons nominated shall be seated at the organizational meeting of the board"; the board appoints only when no one, or too few, were nominated. (The wording already applied to the 27 records. Whether #28497's 2007 claim stands at all is the separate UNSUPPORTED finding in appointed-terms-audit-2026-10-05.md.)

Hart Union High School District trustee post that Peter Warren vacated in March. ... Aliano is scheduled to be sworn in Wednesday. ... rows.sourcePassage: George Aliano was chosen from eight applicants interviewed this weekend by the four other board members to fill the William S. The Hart district oversees Santa Clarita's three high schools and three junior high schools, with one more of each opening this fall. Trustees opted to fill the seat by appointment rather than pay for a special election

rows.corrected: "George Aliano was chosen from eight applicants interviewed this weekend by the four other board members to fill the William S. Hart Union High School District trustee post that Peter Warren vacated in March." "Aliano is scheduled to be sworn in Wednesday." "Trustees opted to fill the seat by appointment rather than pay for a special election."

rows.title: Lyon, Wiley and Jenkins Drill at Pico Canyon
rows.quotation: We agree to put up an equal amount of money to drill one well or more at Camp Pico ... Sanford to oversee operations ... Will call the first well Lyons No. 1 ... /s/ W.W. Jenkins Sanford Lyons H.C. Wiley Jan. 8, 1869. We went down about 50 ft., got about 9 barrels a day. When Alex Mentry took over operations ...
rows.sourcePassage: We agree to put up an equal amount of money to drill one well or more at Camp Pico in Pico Canyon, where Lopez told us about the oil seepage and taking tar & oil to San Fernando Mission later. Sanford to oversee operations as he is much more knowledgeable regarding drilling but to have our full cooperation at all times. If any, profits from said wells to be divided equally. Will call the first well Lyons No. 1 as Sanford is getting the bad end of it. /s/ W.W. Jenkins Sanford Lyons [sic] H.C. Wiley Jan. 8, 1869 We went down about 50 ft., got about 9 barrels a day. When Alex Mentry took over operations
rows.note: A legal agreement: the ellipses join clauses of the 1869 agreement and drop the profit-sharing term ("If any, profits from said wells to be divided equally."), the reason Sanford oversees ("as he is much more knowledgeable regarding drilling but to have our full cooperation at all times") and why the well is named Lyons ("as Sanford is getting the bad end of it"). Each kept clause is accurate; no clause is attached to another's subject. The quotation also drops "[sic]" after "Lyons" and adds a period after "1869".
rows.corrected: Quote the agreement whole: "We agree to put up an equal amount of money to drill one well or more at Camp Pico in Pico Canyon, where Lopez told us about the oil seepage and taking tar & oil to San Fernando Mission later. Sanford to oversee operations as he is much more knowledgeable regarding drilling but to have our full cooperation at all times. If any, profits from said wells to be divided equally. Will call the first well Lyons No. 1 as Sanford is getting the bad end of it. /s/ W.W. Jenkins Sanford Lyons [sic] H.C. Wiley Jan. 8, 1869"; then Jenkins's recollection separately: "We went down about 50 ft., got about 9 barrels a day. When Alex Mentry took over operations ..."
